data.review_body: I think we all know about Temu, motto being..YOU GET WHAT YOU PAY FOR!! I use Temu. A LOT!! And I dont do cheap and nasty, l like good quality clothing and ANYTHING I buy to be of good quality. But the main stream of their fashion, clothing lines are so hit and miss. Its a shame because they repeatedly have a good design and on the website the clothing looks stunning good spec. It took me about 6 months to start to realize that poor quality was the NORM. But having said that it draws you in, it's like being in a massive giant shopping mall, with no ending.!!!  But I have lessened the amount significantly of the amountof money I  spend on their clothing. Refunds are given quickly, easy to order, but the delivery is very long. My delivery on average have taken 16 days. And I have ordered multiple  multiple times. It is a great shopping line to have and use if you are shopping on a very tight budget. Everything is affordable. But quality needs to be more effective.
data.review_headline: I think we all know about Temu

data.review_body: I have become very disillusioned with Temu as have many other people I have heard of who have stopped buying. There were so many times over the last 6 months I went to buy something only to be met with extremely aggressive marketing methods to make me buy things I don't want and distracted me from the things I want. The 6 items free lotto is a complete joke. When you start to go through the process of it, hours on down the line you are trying to find some piece of rubbish with inflated prices just to get the one thing you would have bought in the first place for a good price. Temu - please stop this. You might think we're stupid and engage in this trickery but people are wising up to it and have stopped buying. You dont care - eh? Well, you've lost me many times (a good customer) and about 20 people I have spoken to within the last couple of weeks - they are just saying they can't be bothered any more. Its wearisome and we don't have time to spend hours sifting through things. A points system - yes, where if you buy, you gain credits, but that lottery where if you buy one item at £16 then that is 12% or whatever - the way you have it listed is ridiculous. The tactic of creating confusion to make people panic buy - we're long past it. Please step up and make your sales straightforward - no more messing around. After that, if you do this, I'll be raising my review up to 5 stars again because I love Temu products.

data.review_body:
Temu tends to carry better quality and reasonably priced Chinese goods. Their agents deliver fairly rapidly and reliably, although their tracking is nowhere near as good as Aliexpress or Amazon.

However, the website and app advertise various rebates and discounts (pending credits) that aren't real even if you complete purchases within the time limits. This is made to look like an annoying game. However, the rewards are not actually issued. Temu also aggressively spams you on communication channels, including WhatsApp.

If it wasn't for this deception, I would rank this site much higher but, I will avoid in the future because of this.

data.review_body:
Temu is what it is, you just have to diligently choose products and check prices before checking out.  It's not Nordstrom or Costco where the customer is always right.  But if you play the game that their website is, you can pay 10-20c on the dollar for items of acceptable quality. The 10day shipping is the price you pay for 75% discounts, if you want it sooner pay more in USA. The website has taught me the incredible markup Americans pay over here for many times the exact same thing. So thank you TEMU,  it's cheap and fun to browse and search price differentials on your site. 
Steve
data.review_headline: Thanks for showing us how marked up other sellers charge us.
